paite: TOUPA'N Zion salte apikik nan lai in, mang nei bang hial i hi ua.
heading: Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna

paite: Huai lai in i kam uh nuihna in adim a, i lei uh lasakna in; huai lai in namte lak ah, TOUPA'N amau a ding in thil thupi ahihsak ahi, achi ua.
TOUPA'N thil thupitak hon hihsak a; i kipak mahmah ahi.
TOUPA aw, ka saltanna ua kipan hon pikik nawn in, simlam luite bang in.
Khitui ke kawm a tuhte'n nuamsatak in a-at ding uhi.
Kap kawm a buhchi kuankhiakpihmi in, abuhphalte uh tawi in nuamsa in ahong pai nawn ding hi.
